name: waveshare-8DI-8DO
description: Non-blocking industrial driver for the Waveshare ESP32-S3-POE-ETH-8DI-8DO: safe-boot outputs, opto-isolated 24V inputs with debounce/edge/pulse/RPM, I2C-expander outputs with a mutex-guarded shadow register, non-blocking ejector and CIP state machines, and a Modbus RTU slave over isolated RS485.
keywords: waveshare, esp32-s3, industrial, modbus, rs485, digital-io, ethernet, w5500, can, safe-boot
_comment_dependencies: NO registry dependency on miq19/eModbus on purpose. This project vendors an
RTU-only subset at lib/eModbus (see lib/eModbus/README.md). Declaring the
registry package here made PlatformIO download it into .pio/libdeps on every
dependency resolution — dragging in Ethernet + AsyncTCP + ESPAsyncTCP, the
exact transitive deps the vendoring exists to avoid — and then not even use
it, because lib/ takes precedence over libdeps/. If you unvendor eModbus,
add it to lib_deps in platformio.ini instead.
